title: Multimedia Alat Peraga Pendidikan
description: An interactive educational system built with Flutter and integrated with a microcontroller. Educational objects appear in grids and sliders; selecting an object activates a physical spotlight through a relay module to highlight the corresponding real-world object.
implementationNotes: The deployed system used a touchscreen device connected to physical hardware. The Windows version shown in the recording was used for preview purposes.

id.title: Multimedia Alat Peraga Pendidikan
id.description: Aplikasi pembelajaran interaktif yang dibangun menggunakan Flutter dan terintegrasi dengan Arduino Uno serta modul relay. Ketika pengguna memilih objek pembelajaran pada aplikasi, sistem akan mengaktifkan spotlight fisik untuk menyorot objek yang sesuai di lingkungan nyata.
id.implementationNotes: Sistem yang digunakan terhubung ke hardware melalui perangkat touchscreen. Versi Windows yang terlihat dalam rekaman digunakan untuk preview.

en.title: Multimedia Educational Teaching Aid
en.description: An interactive educational application built with Flutter and integrated with Arduino Uno and a relay module. When a user selects an educational object in the application, the system triggers a physical spotlight to highlight the corresponding real-world object.
